text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: 1st place... I brought it home, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: 1st place... I brought it home, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Ehehe, it really feels great♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The battle isn't over yet, though.
That's right, tomorrow is—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Announcing the results of the very first Cutie Derby♪!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Around noon the next day. Having finished tallying
the "Uma-Likes," I gathered Curren Chan and Biko Pegasus.
Naturally, the announcement was also livestreamed.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: *Gulp*...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Kuh, I lost...!
choice_data_list: Still, it was a close call.
But it was close, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both of their total "Umai-ne" counts were almost identical,
meaning Curren Chan barely managed to pull ahead
thanks to having posted more frequently.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Still, I lost. Both the race and the "Cutie Derby♪"... That fact doesn't change.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, Curren-senpai!
Why did I lose?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If I had to say, maybe it's
the difference in "who they were trying to reach."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren stayed true to cuteness.
After all, everyone loves cute things, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Promote it right, and it'll resonate with anyone.
That's why I think people of all ages and genders gave us their Umalikes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Instead of promoting yourself far and wide,
you chose to share what brings you pure joy, right Biko-chan?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Now that we have so many options to play around with,
it's way easier to recreate Carrotman!
All the hero fans loved it too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I see... I just haven't
appealed to enough people yet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's not about good or bad, you know?
There are winners and losers because it's a project, but that's just a guideline.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
What's important is that competing with Biko-chan
made the Takamatsunomiya Kinen super exciting♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Just take a look♪

text_block_list.name: TV Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"'Now for today's trending news,
let's start by taking a look at this footage!'"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Waaaah... *cheering*...
Curren Caaahn!"

text_block_list.name: TV Reporter
text_block_list.text:
""Here is footage from yesterday's Takamatsunomiya Kinen.
Incredible, what a massive crowd has gathered!
Reports indicate attendance was three times higher than typical years.""

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
"I know about that. Apparently the running Umamusume are doing some interesting projects.
Thanks to that, more people have been visiting the racecourse."

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text: “Cute Curren Chan!”

text_block_list.name: TV Reporter
text_block_list.text:
""!? W-Well, in any case,
keep your eyes glued to the sprint division going forward!""

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The race got so exciting
it made the news!
Isn't that amazing?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: So thank you, Biko-chan.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Thank YOU, Curren-senpai.
This match has helped me grow yet again.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"The next time we meet, I won't be the same as before.
Curren-senpai—I'm definitely gonna beat you!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, sure thing!
I'll turn the tables on you again next time♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "...Curren-senpai might actually fit the role of a monster surprisingly well..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~?
Could you at least call me the "Boss of Cuteness" instead?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the first round of the Kawaii Derby♪
concluded with Curren Chan's victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet the battle continues.
We promptly headed to a family restaurant
for our next strategy meeting. And then—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Big Brother.
About Curren's next race..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis.
About Curren's next race...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren wants to take on
the Sprinters Stakes for a second time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In a rare turn of events, Curren Chan was the one to bring up a race she wanted to run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sprint GⅠ races are few and far between. That's why
I wanted to propose entering the Sprinters Stakes a second time.
However—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You know, I think I told you before that I already
got permission from the Cute Derby♪ participants, but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Back then, everyone was saying the same thing:
that they were planning to aim for the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think this is a super simple
and just-right development?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Curren is on a total roll right now
after beating Biko-chan.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then with this momentum,
maybe I'll just take on all of you at once~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The remaining members are Taiki Shuttle,
Hishi Akebono, Sakura Bakushin O...
Every single one of them is a world-class rival.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, Onii-chan.
There's no need to come up with counters for every single one of them, right?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, Onee-chan.
There's no need to come up with counters for every single one of them, right?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Because the stage Curren runs on is the sprint division.
As long as Curren is the fastest, she'll win... right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In theory, yes. However,
the race isn't the only thing we need to prepare for this time."
choice_data_list: There's also the 'Kawaii Derby♪', you know.
There's also the 'Kawaii Derby♪', you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The rules state that points are tallied only from each social media platform. In other words, unlike before where we just needed to post on UmaTok, we'll have to stay active across all platforms.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry about that either.
Do you really think Curren would cut corners?
choice_data_list: I'm worried because you don't think that way.
I'm worried precisely because you don't think that way.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
But you know, Curren is really okay!
Because I can already see a wonderful future ahead.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Now that we've beaten Biko-chan content-wise, if we announce an impactful 'All-Out Final Showdown,' it'll generate even more hype!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: With all eyes on us, Curren will beat everyone and climb straight to the top in just one day!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—And as the most beloved Umamusume,
I'll be etched into everyone's hearts forever!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "I can finally show Big Brother, can't I? Curren amidst the roaring applause...♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "I can finally show Big Sister, can't I? Curren amidst the roaring applause...♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan chooses the tougher path. What could possibly be waiting ahead on her journey...? Let's watch for the answer at the Sprinters Stakes!
